description: Fetches the structured transcript, title, duration, and timed segments for any YouTube video or Shorts URL.

language.description: Optional language code (e.g. "en", "es", "fr"). Defaults to available English or primary track.

url_or_video_id.description: The YouTube video URL (watch, shorts, youtu.be, embed) or raw 11-character video ID.
